rank_ad.information_correction: leave-one-fold cross-information, floor at I1/2, then cumulative maximum

D1.scale: 0.5 if X1<0, else 2; divide by sqrt(2.125) for unit marginal variance
D1.learner: Scenario A cubic spline 5 knots including endpoints, 10 interactions, GCV [0.1,1,10,100], squared loss with separate outcomes

D3.odd_only: same tolerance and correction on degrees 1,3,5
D3.mixed: fixed J1+J2 one-step from Rank-W; both moment root and one-step limit reported

implementation.seed_components: [master, scenario_index+1, n, rep_0based, stage_index+1, stream_index+1] in dgp.py
implementation.oracle: not applicable; dependent errors and no independent-error efficiency benchmark
implementation.sandwich_rank_ad: same adaptive slope weights and information correction; uses empirical cross-moments for Gaussian max-t
